High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
M/s Jai Beverage and anr. ...Petitioner(s)
Through: Mr. Rajesh Barra, Adv. with Mr. Vikas Malik and Mr. Iqbal
 Bhat, Adv.
 Vs.
Ut of J&K and Ors.

Through:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Puneet Gupta, Judge.

The contention of the learned counsel for the petitioners is that the impugned notices issued to the petitioners by respondent No. 2 are not tenable as the case of the petitioners is not covered by Rule 6 of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 as mentioned in the notices, as the case of the petitioners is covered by provisions of Food Safety and standards Act,
2006.
Issue notice to the respondents in the main as well as in CM returnable within four weeks.
Requisite steps for service within one week.

Till final order is passed by respondent No. 2 on the notices issued by the said respondent, no further punitive action shall be taken by the respondents against the petitioners on the basis of the impugned notices till next date of hearing.
